anomalies.description: A man in a black jacket grabs the man in the blue suit from behind and appears to strike or choke him, causing the blue-suited man to recoil violently.; The man in the blue suit is seen with his hands raised defensively as the attacker (in black) confronts him face-to-face; physical contact is evident.; A man in a suit is attacked from behind; his face is struck and he is grabbed, indicating mutual or one-sided physical combat.

The attacker in black delivers a visible strike to the face/neck of the man in the blue suit, who is recoiling with hands up in defense.; The attacker in black has the man in the blue suit in a close hold or chokehold, lifting or forcing him backward in a room with furniture and lamps.; The attacker in black holds a gun to the head of the man in the blue suit, who is seated or restrained; this constitutes armed physical coercion and is part of the ongoing fight.
A man in a black leather jacket engages in close-quarters combat with the suited man, including grappling, striking, and using a firearm as a bludgeon.

A chaotic multi-person struggle occurs near the staircase: the attacker in black is engaged with at least two others, including the man in blue, involving grappling and rapid motion.; A man in a black leather jacket engages in a physical struggle with another man, who is on the ground; the attacker appears to be subduing or striking the other person.
After being subdued, the suited man is on the floor while the attacker stands over him and appears to strike or press down; the victim is clearly helpless.
A hand holds a handgun in a firing grip; though no muzzle flash is visible, the posture and context strongly suggest a shot was fired (consistent with the victim falling).

The man in the leather jacket is shown in motion, leaning forward aggressively with a tense expression, immediately preceding the scene where two individuals are lying on the floor—suggesting he has just engaged in physical combat that incapacitated them.
A man in a black leather jacket is seen kneeling over two unconscious or incapacitated individuals on the floor and actively searching one of them, removing a handgun from their waistband.

After the initial fight, the attacker stands over two incapacitated individuals lying on the floor and proceeds to search one of them, specifically removing a badge from the waistband of the prone man’s trousers—indicating exploitation of a helpless victim.
The man continues to handle the retrieved handgun, inspecting it closely while still crouched over the victims, indicating ongoing control and exploitation of the helpless state of the others.
